contracts.entry: After outer Race/Archetype tree or gate skip; retain earlier identity/inventory/history and active policy sources.
contracts.reaction: Each actual Backstory/event result adds committed context and a narrator/meme/text reaction; future results remain unknown.
contracts.probability: Equal1/38 base before permitted conditional modifiers. Keep hard eligibility/frozen results. Active Equalizer makes the remaining eligible actual wheel uniform.
contracts.effects: Lore context, future probability modifiers, direct grants/bonuses and additional wheel events are separate. A result may have lore/odds only with empty directEffects and eventRules. Names/AI narration never create an implicit gift.
contracts.bonusTiming: Record declared numeric/mastery modifiers, calculate at finalization. Keep raw rolls immutable and final scores signed/unbounded.
contracts.inventory: Exclude already-owned powers before acquisition draws; identical fixed grants merge source provenance. Normal shared Power Mastery/per-weapon mastery retained.
contracts.return: Complete immediate events and restore saved callers, then Size once; deferred tickets wait for their own stage.
contracts.replay: Freeze version,eligible IDs,odds,result,source ledger and caller before event execution; no redraw/double reward.
contracts.noEvent: After actual Backstory commit and its normal reaction, a result with empty eventRules continues directly to Size; it may still retain a source-owned future-odds profile. Missing/null means undecided, not an approved no-event outcome.
contracts.oddsTiming: Register approved source-owned probability modifiers when Backstory commits; apply only to configured future wheels before pool freeze/draw. Earlier Race/Archetype and other committed outcomes never change. Missing numeric profiles stay pending for later wheel design, never guessed from lore.
contracts.oddsVsBonus: A greater probability of a high/low stat, power or weapon is not an automatic numeric bonus/debuff, guaranteed result or extra spin. Specific weight factors and target wheels must be authored explicitly.
contracts.oddsPrecedence: Use framework/spec.json probabilityContract. Hard eligibility/owned-power exclusions/explicit guarantees apply; active Equalizer flattens remaining eligible odds and suppresses ordinary lore biases. No lore profile bypasses hard guards or rebalances a frozen pool.
